[SWS_CRYPT_02706]
⌈
If the parameter suppressPadding is set to
FALSE, the interface ProcessBlock shall add padding as specified by the AlgId.
If the parameter suppressPadding is set to TRUE, the interface ProcessBlock
shall not add any padding.
